## Claims
- [source-backed] For tall \(\nu\in\decomp_\varphi\) with \(\nu_B\ne\emptyset\), the source states only
  \[
  \mathrm{Reduce}_\varphi(\nu)=(-1)^{|\nu_B|+1}(1\otimes\overline{s}_{(\nu_B)'}).
  \]
  [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 667-672]
- [source-backed] The signed Hopf ingredient is stated for \(\nu\ne\emptyset\):
  \[
  \sum_{\lambda,\mu}(-1)^{|\lambda|}c_{\lambda,\mu}^{\nu}s_{\lambda'}s_\mu=0,
  \qquad S(s_\lambda)=(-1)^{|\lambda|}s_{\lambda'}.
  \]
  [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 702-717]
- [source-backed] The source states the transposed generating family
  \[
  \{\overline{s}_\mu\mid i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\},
  \]
  and says that one “could straightforwardly” transpose the arguments to prove its minimality. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-840]
- [unsupported] No supplied bounded locator states the requested signed equality in an indecomposables quotient \(J_v/A_+J_v\), including its two sides, sign exponent, and conventions.
